refreshNotes: All-new model variant for 2026. The Lyriq-V is the high-performance V-Series version of the Lyriq, with retuned dual motors (615 hp, 646 lb-ft), 3.3 second 0-60, 285 mile range, V-Series styling, performance brakes. Base MSRP $80,390, Premium trim above. Sources: [Edmunds 2026 Lyriq-V](https://www.edmunds.com/cadillac/lyriq/2026/v/), [KBB 2026 Lyriq-V](https://www.kbb.com/cadillac/lyriq-v/2026/specs/).
